_doc: Quests the game finishes on its own once every quest in `by` is finished. DofusDB cannot tell: their objectives are free text with no quest link. Shared by every Dofus; build_quests_js.py writes the ones on each route as COMPLETED_BY in quests.json. 653 (Frigost, une île pas comme les autres) is left out: dungeons complete it, not quests.
